title: BActoalert prepared 16S FASTA samplesheet
description: One sample per FASTA file; every contained 16S sequence is reported independently.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must start with a letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, underscores, dots or hyphens.

fasta.errorMessage: fasta must point to an existing .fa, .fna or .fasta assembly, optionally gzip compressed, with no spaces in its path.
